Subject: PoC hosting readiness & proposed PoC timeline (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private VPC)

Hi Caroline,

Thanks again for the call today — useful discussion. Quick recap and asks to confirm so we can finalize the PoC plan:

- Deployment mode inputs you gave: primary preference = Private VPC (data residency + audit requirements); contingency = Dedicated (reserved capacity) if timeline is tight; Hosted not preferred for PHI.
- Expected steady-state: ~45 qps read-heavy inference with spikes to 120 qps during batch runs.
- Data residency: US East only; retention policy: 90 days raw logs; need SOC2 + audit trail for access.

Action items I need from you to lock the PoC mode & timeline:
1) Confirm whether a Private VPC network/peering request can be approved by your infra team within 3 weeks.
2) Share contact for procurement (I see procure@medlyhealth.com) to route the SOW/PO.
3) Any additional compliance docs we should include in the first pass (besides SOC2)?

Attached a short PoC requirements matrix and a hosting feature comparison to help pick the minimum viable mode for the trial.

Proposed PoC timeline (subject to your infra approval):
- Week 0: PO/SOW signed, initial kickoff
- Week 1–2: Network setup (Private VPC) or Dedicated capacity reservation + model onboarding
- Week 3–4: Integration + smoke tests (sample traffic)
- Week 5: End-to-end validation against success criteria

Suggested PoC success criteria (we can refine):
- Latency P95 < 350ms for 1k token sequences under 45 qps steady load
- Token cost per 1k under agreed threshold
- No data egress outside US region; audit logs available to Medly

Could you confirm the infra timeline and the two contacts above? I'll coordinate pricing and runbook with Ben and Marcus.

Thanks,

Rachel Kim
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.ai
